requirement_text:
Organisation: Apollo Hospitals
Segment: Healthcare — Patient Engagement

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
TOOLS AND TECH STACKS: Python, TensorFlow, React, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools
KNOWLEDGE BASE SOURCES: Clinical guidelines, Internal medical protocols, Symptom checkers, Evidence-based medicine resources
SUPPORTED LANGUAGES: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu
PERSONA AND TONE: Empathetic, informative, supportive, culturally sensitive
FALLBACK MECHANISMS: Escalate to a human clinician, Emergency service dial-out, Provide callback options
LLM FOUNDATION MODEL: GPT-4o, MedGPT
EXPECTED OUTCOME: 40% reduction in call center volume within six months, patient satisfaction score above 4.2 out of 5, zero clinical safety incidents attributable to chatbot advice
REGULATORY CONSTRAINTS: HIPAA compliance, No diagnostic claims, Clinical audit logging, Patient consent management
INTEGRATION REQUIREMENTS: Seamless integration with existing hospital appointment system for real-time slot booking
